```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Loading necessary packages

```{r}
library(fredr) 
library(tsibble) 
library(fable) 
library(feasts) 
library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2)


fredr_set_key("PCOCOUSDM")
```

# Set your API Key programmatically


```{r fetch-cocoa-data}
# Fetching Global Price of Cocoa (US$ per Metric Ton)
raw_cocoa <- fredr(
  series_id = "PCOCOUSDM",
  observation_start = as.Date("2000-01-01"), 
  observation_end = as.Date("2026-03-01")
)

# Convert to a seasonal tsibble object for the fable framework
cocoa_ts <- raw_cocoa %>%
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(date)) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = Month) %>%
  select(Month, value) %>%
  rename(Price = value)

### Initial Visualization Chunk
cocoa_ts %>%
  autoplot(Price) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Price of Cocoa (2000 - 2026)",
    y = "USD per Metric Ton",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
